sam.sales: Heads-up: MidCityBank POC failed to allocate Dedicated GPUs in us-west-2 during reservation step. Demo is tomorrow.

june_se: Error?

sam.sales: They pasted this from UI: `Reservation error: quota_exceeded: requested 8 A100, available 3 in us-west-2`.

leo_platform: Strict-region? mixed-instance?

sam.sales: strict-region=true, strict-hardware=true. Security won't allow cross-region.

june_se: OK options: 1) reduce demo to 3 GPUs (same region) 2) request provider capacity reservation (24-48h) 3) propose mixed (A100+H100) if policy can relax.

leo_platform: Quick workaround: carve a temp 3x A100 pool labeled `poc-midcity-1769400000` and set autoscale=false. I can do that now. Acceptance tests afterwards.

ops-bot: [quota-check] us-west-2: A100 available=3, H100 available=6

june_se: pricing note for customer: reserved 8x A100 in us-west-2 = baseline * 1.3/GPU. Mixed-profile will be prorated. I'll prepare numbers.

sam.sales: Customer accepted reduced demo with 3 GPUs for now but insists on written plan for 8x strict-region commit. They want ETA.

leo_platform: I'll spin the 3x pool now. Tagging ops for provider reservation request if they sign.

ops-bot: [deployment] pool `poc-midcity-1769400000` created with 3x A100 at 2026-03-22T13:02:01Z

leo_platform: running smoke tests: p50=35ms, throughput=800 tks/s. Will share read-only dashboard.

june_se: quote uploaded to ticket MC-POC-9 for both 3x temp demo and 8x reserved 2-week commitment.

sam.sales: Great. Closing thread — follow-up in MC-POC-9.
